    The deck group of Proposition 7.2 is π₁(K) #

    prop:integral-ray-weights: "let G be the free deck group of Subsection 4.2", the fundamental group of the mesh complex K acting on the universal cover. The formalization's deck group is the fundamental group of K with a cone of edges s_X : v₀ → X adjoined (DeckGrading.lean), and Proposition 7.2 is proved for the stabilizer H of the component 𝓛₀ of a base object of the lifted projective category (RayWeightsIso.lean). For a connected quiver whose meshes have nonempty middle terms (the Auslander–Reiten quiver of a connected algebra), this file identifies H with π₁(K, b), b the base vertex, and 𝓛₀ with the lifted projectives of the universal cover of K:

    • the inclusion K ⊂ K ∪ cone (incl) has a retraction (retr, sending s_X to a walk from v₀ to X), so w ↦ s_b w s_b⁻¹ is injective on π₁(K, b) (φ, φ_injective);
    • the degree of a nonzero piece of A₀ is the class of a path (exists_path_of_nz), so the objects of 𝓛₀ are (x, s_b w s_x⁻¹) with w a walk class b → x (conn_δ), and H lies in the image of φ;
    • conversely every walk class is realized by a zigzag of arrows in the lifted quiver (translation edges by the two arrows of a mesh, aconn_δ), whose lifted projectives lie in 𝓛₀ by the support lemma (conn_of_aconn); so the image of φ is H (range_φ, piOneEquiv). The connectedness of the quiver follows from that of A₀ (qConn_of_A0Conn: every vertex receives a nonzero map from a projective, and nonzero maps are combinations of paths); for Γ_A the meshes have nonempty middle terms (IndSkeleton.ar_hmid) and A₀ is connected for connected A (IndSkeleton.a0Conn_ar). Hence Proposition 7.2(1) holds with G = π₁(K, b): W(P) ≅ ℤ^{n−1} ⊕ π₁(K, b)_ab (WPequivFreePi1, theta_summand_pi1), and 𝓛₀ is the lifted projective category of the universal cover, equivariantly (liftEquiv, liftEquiv_act), so the coinvariants (I_𝓛₀)_H of coinvEquiv are (I_𝓛)_G.
